user_story: As a user, I want to view sortable data tables on the application so that I can easily organize and analyze the displayed data. Acceptance Criteria: The page should display a table with the ID 'table1' and 'table2' that includes columns for 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Email', 'Due', 'Web Site', and 'Action'. The action column should contain links with text 'edit' and 'delete'. After sorting the data by any column, the URL should remain the same.
